scenes.name: TWO ARROWS
lines: One arrow alone points nowhere. A second arrow makes an angle.
一支箭头孤悬，说不出指向哪里；来了第二支，才有夹角。
No outside frame is needed: the two diagonals already read that angle.
用不着外部坐标架 C：平行四边形的两条对角线自己就读出夹角。
Three plus one is four. Three minus one, over four, is one half: sixty degrees.

scenes.name: POINT C
lines: Let A be its own axis, and drop a perpendicular from the tip of B.
让 A 自己当轴，从 B 的箭尖向 A 所在的直线作垂线。
The foot is the point C: B's shadow on A, of length cosine theta.
垂足就是点 C：B 落在 A 上的影子，长 cos θ。
The rest stands at right angles, with length sine theta.
剩下的一截与 A 垂直，长 sin θ。

scenes.name: BORN WEIGHT
lines: Squeeze that shadow, from minus one to one, into zero to one.
把影子的取值从 [−1, 1] 线性压进 [0, 1]。
One plus cosine theta, over two, is cosine squared of half the angle: the Born weight.
(1 + cos θ)/2 = cos²(θ/2)：这就是玻恩权重。
Lean checks that the trace pairing is the squared overlap.
迹配对 Tr(ρP) 等于重叠的模平方 |⟨φ|ψ⟩|²，由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: WHY SQUARES
lines: Why the square? Split the arrow along the shutter and across it.
为什么是平方？把箭头沿着快门和垂直于快门拆成两段。
First powers overshoot, fourth powers leak. Only squares always add to one.
一次方之和会超出，四次方之和会漏掉；只有平方之和恒等于 1。
So a shutter and its complement share the whole weight, as Lean confirms.
所以快门 P 与它的补 I − P 恰好分完全部权重；这一条也由 Lean 检验。

scenes.name: INSIDE THE BALL
lines: Now a passing particle records which branch the qubit took.
现在，一颗路过的环境粒子记下了比特走的是哪一支。
Look at the qubit alone: its sideways part shrinks to the records' shadow, while its height stays.
只看这个比特：它的横向部分缩成两条记录的影子 cos θ_env，高度不变。
Once the records are orthogonal, the arrow is a short line on the axis. The weights survive; only the coherence is gone.
两条记录正交时，箭头成了竖轴上一截短线：权重原样留下，只有相干被丢掉。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, part one.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第一部
